features.name: Code review service
features.description: Stefan Moran has started a code review service that provides third-party review of Business Central AL code, including a free automated assessment using a proprietary analyzer and paid detailed review backed by ISO 5055 coding quality standards adapted for AL.
caveats: Free version uses automated assessment only
Paid review service details only partially explained
Not everyone may need ISO compliance
ISO standards are pretty strict and comprehensive

features.name: AL code analyzer
features.description: A proprietary analyzer tool that Stefan has developed which runs against AL codebases using a framework based on ISO 5055 standard with 170+ rules mapped and adapted for AL language, with additional custom rules for Business Central specific issues. Runs approximately 1500 automated tests.
caveats: Some ISO 5055 rules not applicable to AL like memory exploits
Still being expanded with additional custom rules
170 ISO rules mapped to AL
memory exploits excluded by definition

features.name: AI-assisted development in Business Central
features.description: Growing adoption of AI assistants in Business Central AL development, with concerns raised about code quality and need for expert review. Developer approaching 100 percent of code generation through AI, with comprehensive review and testing. Many solutions deployed to production are now heavily AI-generated.
caveats: Quality and best practices of AI-generated code varies
AI agents may not understand Business Central framework constraints well
Requires comprehensive review and testing
Manual cleanup sometimes faster than AI
Not fire-and-forget approach

features.name: Cloud Code AL development workflow
features.description: A development workflow using Cloud Code exclusively because frameworks are changing quickly. Implements AL instructions in a plugin via marketplace that can be copied into projects with a single-line JSON config file for reuse across multiple AL projects. Cloud Code allows running shell commands directly within the session using exclamation mark syntax.
caveats: Workflow changes practically every day
Reduces context burn for non-AL instructions
Plugin marketplace is local to developer's hard drive
More common among Linux users than Windows users

features.name: Flow Next file-backed agent workflow
features.description: A development approach with dedicated agents for solution planning, requirements analysis, writing tests, defining tests, and writing code. All results and context written to files automatically so sessions can be interrupted and resumed by re-reading documentation from disk. Sub-agents write all information to files and return only summaries to the main agent.
caveats: Adapted approach not identical to Flow Next
Specialized for the presenter's development preferences
Default agent communication dumps information back to main agent
Approach predates current memory features

features.name: Multi-agent context management strategy
features.description: Sub-agents write all information to files and return only summaries to the main agent, preventing context overflow. The main agent references files created by previous agents rather than receiving all information back, allowing longer iteration in the same context.
caveats: Default agent communication dumps information back to main agent
Approach predates current memory features

features.name: Iterative AL instruction refinement
features.description: AL instructions are developed iteratively through trial and error. Written initially with AI assistance (Claude), then tested on real projects and revised when issues are discovered or expected behavior differs from actual results.
caveats: Instructions are living documents constantly changing
Not meant as a distributable framework
Personalized for presenter's development process

features.name: Commands framework
features.description: Markdown-based command files with header instructions and prompt body, a predecessor to the skills framework.
caveats: Now deprecated
Being replaced by skills

features.name: Skills framework
features.description: Folder-based agent structure within skills directory containing main skill.md, scripts and documentation, allowing skills to run as sub-agents. Agent can be forced to spawn a sub-agent through skills, providing more control than the previous command approach which only requested sub-agent usage.
caveats: In process of migration
Reworking for container approach

features.name: Problem-driven feature adoption
features.description: Approach to learning new features by reading release notes and adoption only when facing a specific problem to solve, rather than searching for problems for new features.
caveats: Challenging to remember all features
Tool updates very frequent

features.name: Parallel project development
features.description: Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously using AI agents, allowing developers to document one project while writing another and designing a third. Can work on five things in parallel ranging from commercial work to community initiatives.
caveats: Demands significant context management
Causes significant mental exhaustion from context switching
Not sustainable every day, only for intense work sessions

features.name: Terminal UI and File Explorer Navigation
features.description: Developer uses keyboard shortcuts with terminal UI file explorer instead of VS Code for navigation. Mentions keyboard shortcuts to open file explorer terminal, jump to repositories, and navigate with arrow keys.
caveats: More common among Linux users than Windows users

features.name: Arch Linux Development Environment
features.description: Developer uses Arch Linux as the underlying operating system for Business Central development. Cloud Code is noted as being particularly good at helping with Linux support.
caveats: Requires building many components from scratch with Arch Linux

features.name: Windows VM for Reporting
features.description: For handling Business Central reports on Linux and Mac systems, developer maintains a Windows VM. Alternative approaches include parallels with published Office suite.
caveats: Requires separate Windows environment
Parallels alternative on Mac

features.name: Windows VM Running in Linux Docker Container
features.description: Advanced setup where a Windows VM runs inside a Linux Docker container, enabling reporting capabilities without traditional virtualization. Uses Docker file for automated setup with environment variables.
caveats: VMs run unlicensed, must provide own license
One-on-one Docker file setup

features.name: AL Compiler Bash Script Wrapper
features.description: Developer created a bash script wrapper around the AL compiler that automatically discovers VS Code extensions directory, loads DLS, discovers dependency packages, and reduces entire AL compiler command to single 'al-compile' command.
caveats: Cloud Code struggled with command line compilation initially

features.name: Publishing via Curl CLI Command
features.description: Developed bc-publish command using curl and deployment API endpoint from command line. Requires only app file and config file parameters for publishing.
caveats: Testing aspect not fully developed yet

features.name: Docker Containers for Business Central on Linux
features.description: Developer working on running Business Central completely in Docker containers on Linux, creating separate sandboxed environments per project. Currently in prototype stage with stability improvements ongoing. Docker compose setup with SQL Server and BC service containers that replaces the full HTTP implementation with something Linux compatible.
caveats: Still fragile and unstable
Complex dependencies
Previous Wine approach abandoned
Still working on making it more stable
Involves custom workarounds for test execution compared to BC container helper
Requires dependency management

features.name: Standalone Codeunit Execution Without Service Tier
features.description: Experimental approach to run AL codeunits standalone without service tier or app file, using DLS from service directory. Works for simple arithmetic functions and messages but fails with records and dependencies.
caveats: Fails with records and dependencies
Approach abandoned
Prototype on GitHub

features.name: C# HTTP Implementation Replacement for Linux Compatibility
features.description: Cloud Code rewrote C# code to replace HTTP implementation with Linux-compatible version. Allows disabling authorization and encryption in local Docker/CI environments.
caveats: Only works in local/CI environments without authorization or encryption

features.name: Local Linux Service Tier Execution
features.description: Business Central service tier running as net service tier.dll in Linux environment with console output. Enables execution of automated tests in containerized environments.
caveats: Still working on stability
Automated tests partially working

features.name: Automated CLI-based Test Execution
features.description: A command-line interface approach to running BC tests in Docker containers, enabling automation of test compilation, publishing, and execution without manual browser interaction.
caveats: Windows users should prefer BC container helper PowerShell scripts
Linux implementation involves extra work to match BC container helper functionality

features.name: Test-driven Development with AI Code Generation
features.description: A process where tests are written and must fail before any code is generated, providing an approval gate to ensure AI-generated code meets requirements and can be validated before implementation.
caveats: Becomes mandatory when using AI-assisted development at scale
Requires clear documentation for tests that cannot fail upfront

features.name: OData-based Test Exposure
features.description: A custom extension that exposes BC testability via OData protocol, allowing test execution without dependency on management API and web sockets.
caveats: Works as workaround but speaker wanted implementation without this dependency

features.name: AI-driven code generation and language abstraction
features.description: Discussion of how AI can generate code regardless of language, moving toward language-independent development where AI handles the language choice and code generation with minimal human intervention.
caveats: Speculative discussion about future possibilities
No concrete timeline given

features.name: Machine-optimized programming languages
features.description: Speculation that future programming languages may be optimized for AI to write and read rather than for human readability, potentially replacing human-readable languages.
caveats: Entirely speculative
No timeline provided

features.name: Linux Business Central container project
features.description: Work-in-progress project to run Business Central on Linux in containers, with goal of testing against Microsoft test suite to measure performance improvements beyond startup time.
caveats: Still work in progress
Not officially announced yet
Microsoft test suite results not yet available

features.name: Business Central source code history repository
features.description: Public repository maintaining source code for every version of Business Central back to version 15, serving as a resource for developers to access historical versions and updates.
